claims.text: 事实：Alphabet 的业务重心仍是 Google；公司明确说“the largest of which is Google”，并把 Google 分为 Google Services 和 Google Cloud。按 2025 年收入看，Google Services 3427.21 亿美元、Google Cloud 587.05 亿美元，说明未来 3～5 年的首要增长驱动应优先看 Google Services 中的搜索/YouTube/广告再增长，其次才是云业务扩张。

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.

We are focused on building an even more helpful Google for everyone, and we aspire to give everyone the tools they need to increase their knowledge, health, happiness, and success. Google Search helps people find information and make sense of the world in more natural and intuitive ways, with trillions of searches on Google every year. YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program. Google Cloud helps customers build for the future, improve productivity, reduce costs, and unlock new growth engines. We continually innovate and build new products and features to help our users, partners, customers, and communities and have invested more than $200 billion in research and development in the last five years in support of these efforts.

claims.text: 推断：最重要的中期增长催化剂是 AI 对搜索与云的货币化升级。公司披露 AI Overviews、AI Mode、以及 Google Cloud 上的 enterprise AI solutions 可能改变其变现方式，并且“we expect” AI 产品与服务的用户参与度会继续有利于收入；若新形态的变现速度和每次查询/每个客户的收入强度提升，估值上行概率高于仅靠传统广告自然增长的情形。

claims.text: 事实：下行风险的核心仍是广告业务，尤其是搜索广告。公司披露 2025 年超过 70% 的总收入来自在线广告，并明确警示广告主支出下滑、合作方流失、在线广告形态变化、AI 重塑广告行业、隐私政策变化、广告屏蔽技术和宏观放缓都可能损害经营结果。若广告主 ROI 下降或流量迁移，Alphabet 的现金流和估值会首先受冲击。

citations.quote: We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, new and evolving advertising formats, or new or existing technologies that block ads online or affect our ability to personalize ads could harm our business.

We generated more than 70% of total revenues from online advertising in 2025. Many of our advertisers, companies that distribute our products and services, digital publishers, and content providers can terminate their contracts with us at any time. These partners may not continue to do business with us if we do not create more value (such as increased numbers of users or customers, new sales leads, increased brand awareness, or more effective monetization) than their available alternatives.

We believe AI is quickly reshaping the advertising industry, including how ads are delivered online, and we and our competitors are constantly adjusting to meet this shift and provide new and evolving advertising formats. There is no assurance that we will adapt effectively and competitively to meet this shift, and that such advertising formats, strategies, and offerings will be successful.

Changes to our advertising policies and data privacy practices, as well as changes to other companies' advertising or data privacy practices have in the past, and may in the future, affect the advertising services that we are able to provide. In addition, technologies have been developed that make personalized ads more difficult, or that block the display of ads altogether, and some providers of online services have integrated technologies that could impair the availability and functionality of third-party digital advertising. Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.

Expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions. Adverse macroeconomic conditions have affected, and may in the future affect, the demand for advertising, resulting in fluctuations in the amounts our advertisers spend on advertising, which could harm our financial condition and operating results.

claims.text: 事实/推断：AI 基础设施投入是最重要的成本与风险项之一。公司明确预计 2026 年技术基础设施投资将较 2025 年显著增加，而 2025 年资本开支已达 914 亿美元；若投入持续抬升但收入变现滞后，利润率和自由现金流会承压，从而压低估值。
事实/推断：Cloud 安全与数据中心相关并购、以及 Waymo 等 Other Bets 的进展，属于次级上行来源而非主驱动。公司在 2025 年签署收购 Wiz 和 Intersect 的协议；Waymo 也获得外部融资并持续扩张，但 Other Bets 2025 年仍录得 75 亿美元经营亏损。对股价而言，这些业务更像“期权价值”，只有当规模化收入能覆盖投入时才可能显著重估。
事实：公司仍有很强的现金创造和回购能力，这为高投入策略提供缓冲。2025 年经营现金流 1647 亿美元、回购 454 亿美元、总收入 4028 亿美元，说明即使在大规模资本开支下，主业仍能产生大量现金。
推断：对股价影响最大的未知变量，是 AI 相关产品究竟是“增收但低毛利”还是“增收且改善效率”。披露同时提示 AI 货币化方式可能不同于历史模式，而云、订阅、设备等非广告收入的利润率通常低于广告。若收入结构继续向低毛利偏移，盈利质量可能下降，市场可能给出更低倍数。

citations.quote: Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including but not limited to those described below, which could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results, and may affect the trading price and price volatility of our Class A and Class C stock.

claims.text: 反向证据与验证点：虽然非广告收入在增长，但公司也明确说这些收入的利润率通常较低；因此需要持续追踪云业务收入增速、订阅/设备占比、以及广告在 AI 影响下的每次查询和每千次展示变现情况。如果云增速放缓、AI 体验提升但广告变现受损，增长故事会被削弱。

limitations: 材料主要是 2025 年 10-K；没有最新市场一致预期、估值倍数、季度分部利润或更细 AI 商业化数据，无法判断股价短期涨跌幅。
关于‘上行/下行’的判断大多是基于管理层风险提示和财务结构做的条件性推断，不是公司已披露的结论。
Other Bets、Waymo、Wiz/Intersect 等更适合视为次级选项价值或投入项，是否成为主要价值驱动仍取决于后续规模化和盈利转化。
findings: 已纠正草稿中的引用问题：原稿包含无效/未读的 block 引用；本版仅保留成功读取的证据。
业务优先级已按收入规模、管理层表述与风险暴露排序，而不是简单罗列：第一层是搜索/YouTube/广告体系，第二层是 Google Cloud，第三层是非广告收入扩张，第四层是 Other Bets/Waymo 期权价值。
最强反向证据是：公司明确说非广告收入利润率通常低于广告，因此“收入增长”不必然等于“价值提升”；需要看 AI 和云业务是否能在扩大规模时改善或至少不恶化利润率。
股价方向无法从材料中直接推出幅度；缺少市场预期、分部利润、云订单/留存、广告变现效率和资本开支回报等关键数据。
answer.stop_reason: 已审阅年报关键章节并纠正草稿引用错误；材料足以支持优先级与风险框架，但不足以量化股价幅度。
